items.question: Is Mathzle really free?
items.answer: Yes. Two worlds are free forever. Premium unlocks all six worlds plus ad-free and family sharing.

items.question: What ages is it for?
items.answer: Built for ages 6 to 11. Lessons adapt to your kid's level, so a 6-year-old and an 11-year-old can both find their pace.

items.question: Do I need to install anything?
items.answer: No. Mathzle runs in any modern browser on phones, tablets, and computers. No app store, no install, no storage used on the device.

items.question: Will there be iOS and Android apps?
items.answer: Native apps are on the roadmap. For now the browser version delivers the full experience — and updates ship instantly without app-store review delays.

items.question: Is it safe for kids?
items.answer: No ads. No chat with strangers. No data sold. Parents control everything from the family dashboard.

items.question: Does it work offline?
items.answer: Mathzle needs internet to load lessons. Once a lesson is loaded, most activities continue without connection.

items.question: What language is it in?
items.answer: Vietnamese and English. You can switch any time in settings — the numbers feel native in both.

items.question: How is it different from Khan Academy Kids or Prodigy?
items.answer: Three things: it runs in any browser (no install), it's designed for the 6–11 sweet spot specifically, and it ships in Vietnamese first.
